premise.claim: PR body: 'Keep the KEP-284 correctness and performance tools reproducible on the dedicated kep-284-e2e-test branch, as requested in the KEP review' — i.e. split test/podcacheunion (with the R2-F1 and R2-F4 fixes) out of PR #530 into the upstream branch kep-284-e2e-test.
premise.evidence: Collaborator cheyang's comment on PR #530 (issues/comments/6568640028, COLLABORATOR): 'Open a PR from your fork into kep-284-e2e-test that adds only test/podcacheunion, with the R2-F1 and R2-F4 fixes. I'll review and squash-merge it.' The PR adds exactly the 14 files under test/podcacheunion; the 13 non-README files are byte-identical to PR #530 head d1c331ae (verified with git diff), and the README differs only in link targets. Tests-only PR, so no base-branch symptom repro is owed.

unit.note: Fast in-package checks; envtest assets resolved from KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS or /tmp/rbg-assets. The full correctness suite is the integration layer.

findings.evidence: Carried from PR #530 round 2 (same files, byte-identical). Fix present on PR #545 head: envtest.Environment{UseExistingCluster: ptr.To(false)} (envtest_test.go) plus 'export USE_EXISTING_CLUSTER=false' in scripts/transform-campaign.sh. Vendored envtest (server.go:414-419) honors the explicit pointer over the env var. Verified: full race suite green under USE_EXISTING_CLUSTER=true with ~/.kube/config present and KUBECONFIG=/nonexistent/kubeconfig; 'UNION_ENVTEST: isolated Kubernetes v1.31.0 API server + etcd; no external kubeconfig' (results/unit-race-watchlist-off-v.txt). Harness-bites: reverting the pin makes isolation-check.sh exit 1 (results/harness-bites.txt).

Carried from PR #530 round 2. medianRange now averages the two middle values for even-sized groups (transform_measure_test.go) and TestMedianRange covers 1-4 samples including the even cases. Passes on head (results/unit-race-watchlist-off-v.txt).

Carried from PR #530 round 2 (R2-F2), strengthened for this PR's target branch: all seven workflows trigger pull_request/push on 'main' only, so PR #545 (base kep-284-e2e-test) runs zero checks (check-runs total 0, statusCheckRollup empty, combined status 'pending'); nothing in .github/workflows, Makefile, or .golangci.yml references the podcacheunion build tag, so the tagged package is never compiled by CI anywhere. The package leans on exact client-go v0.34.2 FIFO/reflector internals, so a dependency bump can silently rot the KEP's evidence base. ci-coverage-check.sh is RED on head, documenting the gap; it goes green when the branch is added to a workflow's PR filter and a 'go vet -tags=podcacheunion ./test/podcacheunion' step exists (4s on this machine).

nit: README.md links the KEP and performance docs to the author's fork (QIW9/rbg blob at d1c331ae) rather than an upstream location. Correct today (keps/284-pod-cache-filter is not on kep-284-e2e-test yet and d1c331ae is public), but per the collaborator's plan PR #530 will re-point at the merged upstream commit; fork links 404 if the fork is deleted. Prefer upstream links once PR #530 merges.

nit/coverage: union.go's comparison machinery (boundary resolution, prune-on-watermarks, feed bridge, sourceStore) has no correctness test in the package; it is exercised only by the opt-in campaign's union-serial mode, which asserts retained counts and serialized initial lists but not delete/selector-exit boundary semantics. Non-blocking: it is the explicitly rejected comparison design, not the selected transform design.
